column1: # Synth presets for MIDI > CC Mapping. Made with cfw/tools/gen_cc_presets.py, which checks every line against a
# checkout of the MIDI Guide dataset and writes cfw/src/ccpresets.h.
# CC numbers from MIDI Guide (https://github.com/pencilresearch/midi), CC BY-SA 4.0
# and this file is shared under the same licence. Each slot: "CC number=parameter" as the dataset names it
# The firmware's 8 slots are, in order: Cutoff, Resonance, Sample Attack, Sample Decay, Reverb Send, Delay Send, Overdrive, Bit Depth.
